evidence.why: Entry assertions, dirty-state synchronization, debug verification and combined-word condition precede typed command writes.
ASSERTMSGLINE depends on #ifdef DEBUG and otherwise expands to a no-op.

facts.rationale: Corrects the unconditional format-rejection implication while preserving the source's distinct assertion and verification preprocessor conditions and exact flush guard.
facts.value: Uses ASSERTMSGLINE to assert vtxfmt < 8 and reject nesting inside another GXBegin/GXEnd region; these assertions are active when DEBUG is defined and become no-ops otherwise. Before command emission it synchronizes any nonzero dirtyState. Separately, under #if DEBUG, it verifies state when not recording a display list and marks the begin region active. It emits a flush primitive only when the combined cached unk/bpSent word read at &gx->unk is zero, then writes the primitive/format byte and 16-bit vertex count.

evidence.why: Separate line/point fields share lpSize; line setter emits it and clears bpSent.
The consumer tests the combined word rather than bpSent alone.

facts.rationale: Preserves the supported raster-state purpose while correcting the claim that this setter necessarily requires a later primitive flush.
facts.value: Configures GX line rasterization by replacing the eight-bit line-width and three-bit line texture-offset fields in the shared line/point-size shadow register, immediately emitting the updated raster register, and clearing gx->bpSent to zero. This bookkeeping participates in the later conditional primitive flush; GXBegin flushes only when the combined cached unk/bpSent word is zero, not merely because this setter cleared bpSent.
